hook.text: How much CO₂ does shipping one container from Shanghai to Rotterdam produce? 1.2 tons. Somebody counted.

buildup.text: Carbon accounting measures and tracks greenhouse gas emissions across the supply chain.

discovery.text: It assigns emissions to activities—transport, production, packaging—using emission factors and activity data.

twist.text: Data quality is poor. Many emission factors are estimates. Accuracy varies widely across industries.

climax.text: The GHG Protocol is the global standard for carbon accounting. Most major companies now follow it.

punchline.text: You can't reduce what you don't measure. Count the carbon.

quiz.question: What is the global standard for carbon accounting?
